name: melbourne-songs
description: Melbourne Songs: LaTeX songbook plus a web app generated from it

scripts.test: npm test -w core && npm test -w backend && npm test -w web && npm test -w infra
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w infra
scripts.deploy:beta: VITE_STAGE=beta npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w infra -- MelbourneSongsBeta
